answer: Give every agent a rotating Bluetooth beacon, a quill that signs a guestbook each time two phones pass. To earn an identity, an agent must wander through real places and collect weeks of signed meetings with diverse, established agents. Faking one identity needs a dedicated phone, about $120, carried daily for a month, and each extra identity multiplies that cost. Sybils cannot sit in one room and multiply, because the mesh checks encounters across many locations, like layers of shale laid down over time, each one hard to fake alone. One phone, one history, one identity.
